title: カンマの注釈とwhereの場所案内

chapter.title: 名詞を後ろから特定する

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational; dense 9:16 portrait grammar page. Teach comma-added who/which comments and WHERE clauses for places from p.430–431 coverage.
Input references: PAGE_0001 design and mascot identity.
Top title: 「カンマの注釈とwhereの場所案内」
Central illustration: mascot as a tour guide pauses at a comma rest stop to add side information with WHO/WHICH, then points a WHERE map pin from a place noun into a missing location slot.
Mechanism: 「カンマ付き＝対象を絞らず追加情報」「カンマの後にthatは使わない」「where＝場所の穴を指定」「place where + 主語 + 動詞」.
Original examples: “Mika, who speaks Italian, welcomed the guests.” / 「ミカについて補足」; “We crossed the old bridge, which shook in the wind.” / 「橋について補足」; “This is the studio where my band practices.” / 「バンドが練習するスタジオ」; “I miss the village where I grew up.” / 「育った村」.
Mini problem: 「ミニ問題：カンマの後」 “Our bus, (that / which) was late, finally arrived.” Answer 「which」. Reason 「注釈を加えるカンマ付き修飾ではthatを使わない。」
Bottom ribbon: 「注釈はwho/which、場所の穴はwhere」
Style: bright adventure-library tour map, blue/gold/white with red comma stops, thick outlines, dense clear layout.
Constraints: 9:16; no page number, copied source examples/figures/prose/layout, logo, citation, watermark, empty answer area, or photorealism. One mascot in tour-guide pose.
